name: Chronicles of Reflection
source:
The main character is a nameless girl with strange healing powers. She wakes up in the middle of a forest, unable to remember her name, past or how she arrived there. Her only belongings appear to be a blank book with a white gem embedded in its cover. From there, she begins to journey across the many islands of Reflection, meetings its inhabitants and seeking the truth behind her origins. What she encounters on the way will change not only her view of the world but reveal the truth about Reflection itself.

[From [url=http://crimson-daybreak.wikia.com/wiki/Chronicles_of_Reflection]Crimson Daybreak Wikia[/url]]
translation:
主角是一位无名的女孩，拥有奇怪的治愈能力。她在森林中央醒来，记不起自己的名字、过去或如何到达那里。她唯一的物品似乎是一本空白的书，封面上嵌着一颗白色宝石。从那里，她开始穿越反射的许多岛屿，会见岛上的居民并寻找她起源背后的真相。她在路上遇到的事情不仅会改变她的世界观，还会揭示反射本身的真相。

[来自[url=http://crimson-daybreak.wikia.com/wiki/Chronicles_of_Reflection]Crimson Daybreak Wikia[/url]]
